title: Visa Core Rules and Visa Product and Service Rules, 18 April 2026
quote: Section 4.1.24 Agentic Platform Requirements. Definition: 'Agentic Transaction: An Electronic Commerce Transaction that is undertaken by an Agentic Payment Provider on behalf of a Cardholder, using a Payment Credential, that is both of the following: Based on the Cardholder-defined payment instruction(s); Completed both without direct interaction between the Cardholder and Merchant and by submitting the Payment Credential to the Merchant, for the Merchant to complete the Transaction with the Merchant's Acquirer.' Section 4.1.24.3 requires the Agentic Payment Provider to 'Obtain Cardholder acknowledgement that they are responsible for actions taken by the Agentic Payment Provider' and to 'Verify the Cardholder's identity in accordance with the Visa Intelligen[t] Commerce specifications' before storing a credential or acting on an instruction. Section 4.1.24.2 prohibits an Agentic Payment Provider from undertaking an Agentic Transaction in a Card-Present Environment or aggregating multiple Agentic Transactions into a single Transaction. 'Global Agentic Payment Requirements for Digital Wallets, Effective 18 April 2026.' Compelling-evidence dispute provisions accept 'login IDs for an Agentic Payment Provider and Merchant's e-commerce site or application.'
